# GroupDocs.Signature for Python via .NET - examples

> On-premise SDK examples. Formats: 40+ (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, images).

Python SDK that adds, searches, verifies, updates and deletes electronic signatures: text, image, digital (X.509 certificates, .pfx), barcode, QR code, stamp, form-field and metadata signatures.

## Key Features

- Sign PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PNG and other files; several signatures in one call
- Digital signing with certificates (.pfx); PDF signatures use SHA-256 and verify cryptographically
- Search, verify, update and delete existing signatures
- Page and signature previews through Python callbacks
- Python 3.5 to 3.14 (the examples use f-strings and need 3.6+), in scripts, Flask or Django apps
- Runs on Windows, Linux and macOS, in Docker, and on cloud VMs and containers; no Office or Acrobat needed

## Install

```bash
pip install groupdocs-signature-net
```

## Code Snippet

```python
from groupdocs.signature import Signature
from groupdocs.signature.options import DigitalSignOptions

with Signature("sample.pdf") as signature:
    options = DigitalSignOptions("certificate.pfx")
    options.password = "1234567890"
    signature.sign("signed.pdf", options)
```
